name: 101 Dalmatians — Naturalistic fMRI in Congenital Sensory Loss
description: A Figshare release of naturalistic fMRI from 50 participants — typically developing, congenitally blind and congenitally deaf individuals — watching audiovisual, audio-only or visual-only versions of the live-action film 101 Dalmatians. Matching one narrative across three sensory presentations and three populations is what makes it distinctive: it supports direct tests of how congenital sensory deprivation reshapes functional organisation and cross-modal plasticity. The release adds auditory and visual descriptors from VGGish and VGG-19, GPT-4 semantic embeddings, and human-tagged annotations of movie events, all in BIDS, with data quality assessed by inter-subject correlation.
citation: Setti F, Bottari D, Leo A, Diano M, Bruno V, et al. (2025). 101 Dalmatians: a multimodal naturalistic fMRI dataset in typical development and congenital sensory loss. Scientific Data, 12, 1792.
